space.name: Kitting Domain Layout 4
space.notes: Foreseeable-task fixture (scenario_40). One human run in four segments: (1) an assigned delivery with a 1209 cm approach (positive control); (2) a walk from the kitting table to the coffee machine, >= 49.6 deg off every task target seen from the table; (3) a walk to two 'waypoint' markers that no task enumerates - wander_0 lies on the straight line from the coffee machine to shelf_6 (the human heads toward a shelf it will use later), wander_1 is >= 50 deg off every target seen from wander_0 (the human turns away); (4) the delivery from shelf_6. The coffee machine sits alone south of the table; every shelf is on the east or west edge. Every target is >= 50 deg off the segment-1 heading. No obstacles. The ac_switch object uses the type string ac_activation's parameter_types asks for ('ac_switch'); env_layout1 spells it 'AC_switch' and gets no hypothesis (I1 follow-up).

env_objects.notes: Shared delivery sink, top centre. Segment 2 starts here.
Human's first delivery (segment 1). Approach from (100, 550): 1209 cm, bearing -150.3 deg; every other target is >= 50 deg off that heading.
Human's last delivery (segment 4). Segment 3's first waypoint lies on the coffee_machine_0 -> shelf_6 line, 40% of the way.
Robot task 1 (cheapest from its SW start).
Robot task 2 (cheapest from the table after item_4).

Robot task 3, the most expensive from the table, so it is done last and keeps the robot busy until ~375 ticks - the IR is only called while the robot has tasks (I1 7.12). Undelivered during the human's segment 4, where it is 17 deg off the heading (prior-off decoy; inadmissible prior-on).
Segment 2 target. From the kitting table: bearing -93.1 deg, 751 cm; nearest task-target bearing from there is shelf_5 at -43.5 deg (49.6 deg off). x = -40 keeps the walk off the x = 0 zone boundary.
Second foreseeable target; never visited. Type spelled as ac_activation's parameter_types requires.

Segment 3, leg 1 end. Exactly on the coffee_machine_0 -> shelf_6 line (t = 0.4): the human heads toward shelf_6 for 398 cm, then turns. No task enumerates type 'waypoint', so no hypothesis targets it.
Segment 3, leg 2 end. From wander_0: bearing -110.3 deg, 362 cm; >= 64 deg off every target (shelf_5 92.6, coffee 64.0, shelf_6 116.1, table 133.1).
